description: This PHP class `ConfigResolver` provides static methods to load, validate, and merge configuration files that return arrays. It manages file existence and readability checks, and throws exceptions for invalid or inaccessible files.

classes.name: ConfigResolver
classes.description: A utility class for loading and merging configuration files in PHP.

methods.name: loadFiles
methods.description: Loads multiple PHP config files that return arrays, merges their contents into a single array, and validates that each file returns an array.

methods.name: isFileExist
methods.description: Checks if a given file exists and is readable; throws an exception if not.
